answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 55 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an inlet bet on surviving 55 epochs of grading, and every tide settlement recomputes the lagoon schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 40 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
